name: iD WorkStyle® 3
description: A premium occupational lens for presbyopic patients experiencing Digital Eye Strain (DES) from prolonged digital device use.
use_case: Provides relief from DES symptoms and increased productivity. A custom solution for any visual need, creating better visual comfort.
targetUser: Presbyopic patients with heavy digital device usage.

name: Sync III™
description: An enhanced single vision lens for single vision patients experiencing Digital Eye Strain (DES) symptoms.
features: Distance power with a ‘boost zone’ at the bottom
Available in clear, photochromic, and polarized
use_case: Reduces eye strain during prolonged near tasks like using digital screens or reading. Offers comfort unmatched by standard single vision lenses.
targetUser: Single vision patients experiencing Digital Eye Strain.

name: Tact® BKS
description: An occupational lens designed to provide relief from Digital Eye Strain (DES) and improve workstation ergonomics for presbyopic patients.
features: Extended focus for near and intermediate zones
Optimized periphery for wide viewing zones
use_case: Increases productivity and provides relief from DES. Allows movement around the work area without switching glasses (Tact 40). A cost-effective solution.
targetUser: Presbyopic patients needing ergonomic visual solutions for work.
